*A small turn of the wrist catches the blow on a waiting edge and sends it sliding past.*

Before one adjacent enemy makes a melee attack against this creature, impose 1 Bane on that attack roll. Requires a held melee weapon. Against an NPC attack, grant 1 Boon to the single defense roll instead. Applies to this attack only; it does not grant a counterattack.

details.flavorMarkdown: *An armored corpse watches with the offended dignity of a lord whose court has forgotten to die.*
details.specialtyMarkdown:
### Oath-draining blade

**Target:** One adjacent creature. **Player defense:** Fortitude. **Damage type:** Life.

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

**Lifeless Body — Passive:** Does not breathe or eat; only its listed immunities apply.

**Healing:** Healing-harmed: ordinary healing resolves as Life damage instead; no beneficial riders.

**Against offensive healing:** Its controller uses Fortitude defense when player-controlled; a player attacking it rolls only their attack.

**Senses:** Dark sight 6 squares; ordinary hearing.

**Tactics and retreat:** Separate the oath-breaker from companions, then use fear to make the approach costly. It values its old post more than pursuit.

**Encounter and conversation:** It demands a toll once lawful but now ruinous; the original charter can expose its limits.

**Habitat:** Crypt; burial ground; ruined settlement · **Communication:** Common; understands old oaths

**Loot:** Recoverable possessions or lair clues chosen for the adventure; body parts grant no automatic special equipment or coin value.

**Summoning:** Undead 7 — [player reference](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/summons/wight.md).
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-wight


**Category:** Undead · **Role:** Pursuit controller · **CV:** 29

### CV worksheet

**Reference damage:** 3/5/7

**Reference type:** Life

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.4

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.3 → 1.4: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=3.000, O=5.596. Uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/encounters.md). Utility is provisional and does not simulate control, positioning or summon choices.

**Ability sources:** [hampering strike](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/hampering-strike.md), [lifeless body](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/lifeless-body.md), [rattle bones](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/rattle-bones.md), [Turn the Blade](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/turn-the-blade.md).

**Coverage reference:** [Pathfinder family survey](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/family-survey.md); original HOL prose and mechanics.

monsterAbilityTemplates.name: Lifeless Body
monsterAbilityTemplates.flavorMarkdown: *Nothing breathes beneath the torn coat; nothing living looks through the visor.*
monsterAbilityTemplates.rulesMarkdown:
The card must list its exact condition immunities; this trait grants no additional unlisted ones. It does not breathe or need food. Undead entries marked healing-harmed take a healing result as Life damage; constructs marked repair-only do not regain HP from ordinary healing. Neither rule prevents physical attacks from dealing their normal minimum damage.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.

# Lifeless Body

*Nothing breathes beneath the torn coat; nothing living looks through the visor.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-lifeless-body


**Action:** Passive

Undead entries marked healing-harmed take a healing result as Life damage; constructs marked repair-only do not regain HP from ordinary healing. Neither rule prevents physical attacks from dealing their normal minimum damage.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.
